# m.reference.related_companies

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The companies Massive relates to a ticker, from news and returns data, one row each.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.reference.related_companies(symbols)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Underlying` and `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | The tickers to find peers of (`dm.ALL` is refused). |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Related Tickers (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "A ticker related to the requested ticker." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read for the dataset's asset class. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. The column is absent when the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Underlying` | String | The instrument Massive links the row to, as Massive's ticker. For an option, it's the linked instrument, not what the contract delivers. From REST: the request's `ticker` parameter. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant, by the local clock. Every row of one REST page shares it. It isn't Massive's time, and it isn't monotonic. In a `poll()` table, it's the latest poll's time. |
